outcome: Presence and composition of meconium microbiota
finding: Maternal gut and vaginal microbiota contribute to the shaping of neonates' gut microbiota, with gestational age influencing the source of bacteria.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery did not significantly impact the relationship between maternal and neonatal microbiota.
gest_age: Extremely preterm (<28 weeks) and very preterm (>=28 weeks)
